class.name: NetwPredictAckFrame
class.brief_description: One authority-to-owner acknowledgement prefix: the fingerprints authority proves for its oldest unacknowledged run of transitions.
class.description: A frame is built one direction and read the other, sharing this one class rather than a pair of hand-written codecs. Authority calls [method create], appends records oldest first from [method set_base], and asks for [method to_bytes]. An owner calls [method from_bytes] and reads the same columns back through the same accessors. [codeblock] var frame := NetwPredictAckFrame.create() frame.set_epoch(epoch) frame.set_base(oldest_transition) for record in records: frame.append_record(...) send(frame.to_bytes()) [/codeblock] Every record is positional: [method base] names the transition of record [code]0[/code] and each later record names the next transition in sequence, so no record carries its own index. [br][br]The witness class and the acknowledgement flags share one wire byte. [method append_record]'s [param witness_class] and [param flags] parameters are split back apart on read by [method flags] and [method witness_class_bits], so no caller shifts or masks the byte itself.

method.name: append_record
method.description: Appends one acknowledgement record for the transition following the last one appended, or [method base] for the first. [param pre_family_fps] and [param post_family_fps] must each hold exactly the pose, momentum, and controller triple, in that order, or this returns [code]false[/code] and appends nothing. [param flags] and [param witness_class] are packed into one wire byte and read back separately by [method flags] and [method witness_class_bits]. Unlike [method NetwPredictCommandFrame.append_transition], this never refuses for reaching a wire cap; [method to_bytes] is where the per-frame record cap is enforced.

method.name: base
method.description: The transition [method record_count]'s record [code]0[/code] names, set by [method set_base]. Every later record names the next transition after this one, in order.

method.name: c_hashes
method.description: One command hash per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: create
method.description: An empty frame planned against the declared schema, or [code]null[/code] when that schema declares no fixed-width row.

method.name: e_digests
method.description: One environment digest per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: epoch
method.description: This frame's epoch byte, set by [method set_epoch]. An owner reads it to tell a frame from a stream that restarted from one that continues an existing one.

method.name: evidence_masks
method.description: One evidence-kind bitmask per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: flags
method.description: One acknowledgement byte per record, [constant FLAG_SUBSTITUTED] and [constant FLAG_SUPERSEDED] combined, with the witness class bits [method witness_class_bits] carries separately already stripped out.

method.name: from_bytes
method.description: The frame [param bytes] states, or [code]null[/code] when the bytes are not a complete frame of this plan. A caller counts the refusal and drops the datagram, because a partial window has no honest reading.

method.name: post_family_fps
method.description: The post-state pose, momentum, and controller fingerprints, flattened three per record in that order, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: post_fps
method.description: One combined post-state fingerprint per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: pre_family_fps
method.description: The pre-state pose, momentum, and controller fingerprints, flattened three per record in that order, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: pre_fps
method.description: One combined pre-state fingerprint per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: raw_fps
method.description: One unclassified raw fingerprint per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: record_count
method.description: How many records [method append_record] has appended, the bound for every per-record accessor. Unbounded on this side: [method to_bytes] is what truncates to the wire's per-frame record cap, so a caller wanting every record sent checks this count against that cap itself rather than trusting [method append_record] to refuse.

method.name: set_base
method.description: Sets [method base] to [param transition], clamped to [code]0[/code] for a negative value.

method.name: set_epoch
method.description: Sets [method epoch] to [param epoch], truncated to the low 8 bits.

method.name: to_bytes
method.description: Encodes this frame's base and records, the bytes [method from_bytes] decodes back. Silently truncates to the wire's per-frame record cap when [method record_count] exceeds it, oldest records first, rather than refusing to encode.

method.name: topo_fps
method.description: One topology fingerprint per record, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: witness_class_bits
method.description: One witness class per record, the [param witness_class] each [method append_record] call packed into the shared flags byte, in [method base]-relative order.

method.name: witness_fps
method.description: One witness fingerprint per record, in [method base]-relative order.

constants.constant: This record's evidence stands in for a transition authority declared skipped rather than actually drove, so it carries no real drive result.

The transition already carried a real journal row before authority declared it skipped, so this substitution overwrote evidence rather than filling a gap. Always set alongside [constant FLAG_SUBSTITUTED].
